method: Independent offline Python/Capstone static mapping; not native REA Evidence

dram_attributes.evidence_type: Reviewed bounded static disassembly plus checked jump-table words
dram_attributes.api_contract: Returns zero for selector 0 or values >=7. Cases 1..6 return one. Non-null a1 receives the supported DRAM byte-size value. Other non-null output arguments receive attributes; byte-size query handler passes a2=a3=arg5=0.
dram_attributes.handler_contract: Calls API with a1=&stack_u32; if success, shifts byte count right 20 for MiB and multiplies that result by eight for printed Mbit. No actual selector value was read.
dram_attributes.limitation: Six supported software cases are not six observed devices; register reset/current value and actual camera geometry remain unknown.

clock_interface.evidence_type: Reviewed bounded static disassembly; runtime state unavailable
clock_interface.lookup_contract: Index a0 is checked unsigned <0x38; returns indexed u32 at 0x808a5b8c or zero. Table contents are outside the file-backed analysis image.
clock_interface.finding: cguop get path passes parsed/default clock ID to frequency lookup; set path validates a requested frequency then prints reachable and achieved values. cgucfgen parses clock id/frequency/mode and invokes configuration paths.
clock_interface.clock_id_names_and_units: Frequency diagnostics say Hz; exact ID-to-clock table remains unresolved
clock_interface.limitation: An available frequency getter does not reveal the installed operating clock or authorize clock changes.

platform_identity.evidence_type: Embedded diagnostic/source-path strings, not a chip-ID read
platform_identity.inference: Firmware contains Zoran camera-platform software, ThreadX-named RTOS diagnostics and FileX-named filesystem objects. C13 and multiple processor labels are software-family leads.
platform_identity.limitation: Bundled drivers and monitor help can cover unused hardware variants; strings do not prove fitted chips or enabled cores.

gpio.evidence_type: Reviewed driver/monitor disassembly plus checked file-backed table
gpio.pin_io_contract: a0=group index, a1=pin index, a2=value for write; table[group*0x54].u32_at_8 gives base; read/write u32 at base+0x0c+4*pin. Getter returns loaded u32. Writer returns one.
gpio.monitor_side_effects: gpioset and gpioget both invoke enable/configure and direction routines before pin I/O. gpioget therefore is not a passive hardware read. Monitor diagnostics explicitly say GPIO state is not restored.
gpio.direction_values: Monitor output path passes direction argument0; input path passes1. Driver updates cached mask at record+4 and writes it to register_base+4. Register bit meanings inferred from these callers.
gpio.bounds: No group/pin validation in these short pin-access leaf APIs; observed table groups0..10 are not authorization to call arbitrary indices.
gpio.limitation: The two byte maps are retained raw. Pad identities, pin mux state, board wiring and attached devices are not established.

allocator.evidence_type: Reviewed static initialization and dispatch windows
allocator.initialization_contract: Queries DRAM byte size through0x8003c3ac. On success derives a candidate pool extent from reported size, the caller-provided start masked with0x0fffffff, and a four-byte deduction; failure reports Unknown main DRAM size. This ties allocator sizing to runtime geometry rather than ELF extent.
allocator.dispatch_contract: Entry saves a0..a3 plus a fifth argument; when a0 pool pointer is nonzero, reads pool+8 then calls its first u32 function pointer with pool,size and forwarded metadata/flags. Other/default-pool branches need further work.
allocator.limitation: Byte/page/fixed allocator source paths establish multiple allocator families, not usable headroom or complete ownership/free semantics.

rtos_primitives.evidence_type: Diagnostic names plus selected implementation disassembly
rtos_primitives.semaphore_get_contract: Selected routine receives a0=object and a1=wait/control parameter; checks word at object+8, decrements it on the immediate-acquire path, and has a suspension path using thread/queue bookkeeping. Error paths reference _tx_semaphore_get. Full status values and tick units remain unresolved.
rtos_primitives.cpu_context_selection: Selected allocator/RTOS windows use MFC0 register15 select1, mask0x3ff and compare with1 to choose context. This does not recover the processor model or prove active core count.
rtos_primitives.limitation: Diagnostic function names are useful entry anchors, not recovered symbols or complete callable ABI definitions.

dma.evidence_type: Reviewed static transaction-submission window and diagnostic strings
dma.contract: Given a0 context, stores a2,a1,a3,stack_arg5,stack_arg6 at context+0x18,+0x1c,+0x20,+0x24,+0x28; clears byte+0x2c, copies context byte0 to+0x2d, calls0x8005d02c(context+0x10). Nonzero stack_arg7 additionally calls0x8005d140(context). Returns one on the shown paths.
unresolved: Meaning and units of each transaction field
Cache maintenance and alignment for each engine
dma.limitation: The GSIU diagnostic requiring transfers multiple of4 is subsystem-specific and must not become a universal DMA rule.

String references are scanned in mixed code/data and can be false positives.
High-address accesses use only 5,798 compiler-unwind ranges, not all code; unsupported instructions and control-flow boundaries drop constants.
